messages:
maria: heads up — PR #8722 bumped p95 on the alloc path in the small-batch microbench. attaching perf summary and a short heap snapshot link.

maria: summary: p95 went from 48ms -> 83ms on 1k token longseq (perf harness v2), mem +12MB steady-state. not huge but blocks our SLA for small-batch customers.

aj: ack. can you paste the bench command and exact commit hash?

maria: command: `./bench/run --profile=small-batch --iters=200 --seed=42`  commit: `3f9a2c7`

devon: looking quickly — is this on canary or local cpu? microbench mentions `alloc-refactor` in PR title, could be tiling change that increased copies.

maria: canary. config: 1xA100, batch horizon=16, adaptive-tiling=on. PR changes the shard packing loop around kv-cache prefetch.

bench-bot: perf report: https://perf.internal/bench/8722  (graphs: p50/p95/p99, mem timeline). note: test variance ~3-5% normally.

sam: from the graph it looks like two clusters — pre-PR and post-PR separated with a tail spike at ~80-90ms. do we have histograms?

maria: pasted key hist snippet:
```
pre-PR p95 48ms, p99 102ms
post-PR p95 83ms, p99 180ms
p50 roughly same
```

aj: interesting that p50 unchanged — suggests outliers or serialization path. can you run a run with `--trace=tail` enabled to capture slow traces?

maria: running now, will share trace link. ETA ~12m.

devon: also try disabling adaptive-tiling to confirm interaction: `--adaptive-tiling=false` (quick A/B helps isolate)

maria: good call. queued two runs: baseline (tiling on) and tiling off. hashes: `3f9a2c7-tiling-on` and `3f9a2c7-tiling-off`.

bench-bot: run results: tiling-off p95 50ms, tiling-on p95 82ms. trace: https://traces.internal/trace/8744

sam: wow that's a smoking gun — the change likely interacts with tiling. can you bisect which hunk causes it? maybe revert packing changes in small patch to test.

maria: I can try a revert of the inner-loop only. will open a draft PR (8724) with revert and run same bench.

aj: if revert fixes, plan: ship revert as hotfix, then we can iterate on preserving behavior but keeping perf. need 1 approval from runtime leads for hotfix.

devon: I'll +1 on hotfix after bench verifies. also add a test that covers tail behavior for small-batch longseq.

maria: posted draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/8724 — bench shows p95 49ms, mem back to baseline.

sam: cool. @devon can you give the quick review+approve? I want to avoid blocking next deploy window.

devon: will review now. small comments inline but nothing blocking. approving now. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks! rolling the revert to canary in 10m, will monitor. will follow up in #incidents if any regression.

bench-bot: deploy successful to canary at 1719804800. smoke check p95 51ms.

maria: final note: keep PR #8722 open — we'll rework packing with extra guardrails and add microbench coverage. filing a follow-up ticket for design review.

aj: thanks for the quick turnaround. marking this thread resolved unless new issues pop.
